metadata.description: Staff-contributed Claude Code plugins for Mattermost engineering workflows

plugins.name: code-simplifier
plugins.description: Simplifies and refines code for clarity, consistency, and maintainability while preserving all functionality

plugins.name: conflicts
plugins.description: Git merge conflict resolution agent that analyzes intent behind changes on both branches

plugins.name: figma-implement-design
plugins.description: Translate Figma nodes into production-ready code with 1:1 visual fidelity using the Figma MCP workflow

plugins.name: precommit
plugins.description: Pre-commit expert that discovers, runs, and resolves all code quality checks in a monorepo

plugins.name: test-evaluator
plugins.description: Reviews existing tests for efficacy, correctness, and coverage gaps, prioritizing real interactions over mocking

plugins.name: teamimplement
plugins.description: Orchestrate phased software implementation using a team of engineers with dedicated research, planning, implementation, code review, and QA stages

plugins.name: issue-resolver
plugins.description: Autonomous issue resolution agent that investigates, plans, and fixes issues using sub-agents and browser-based validation

plugins.name: mattermost-test-data
plugins.description: Backfill realistic test data into a Mattermost server using MCP tools — creates users, teams, channels, and natural conversations

plugins.name: claude-md-improver
plugins.description: Audit and improve CLAUDE.md files in repositories — scans, scores quality, and makes targeted updates

plugins.name: mattermost-plugin-development
plugins.description: Update Mattermost plugin repos from the starter template and fix linter issues
